description: Synthetic evaluation cases specifying conservative expected dispositions; fixture assertions are not evidence that a production matcher executes these rules.

scenarios.description: Unique exact amount, currency and reference.

expected.rationale: All supplied identifying fields agree uniquely.

scenarios.description: Exact amount with same reference but a one-day posting lag.

expected.rationale: Unique reference and amount agree; small date lag is explicit.

scenarios.description: Exact value and date, but two identical ledger candidates.

expected.rationale: Duplicate candidates make one-to-one assignment uncertain.

scenarios.description: Exact numeric amount but conflicting references.

expected.rationale: Conflicting identifiers prevent automatic attribution.

scenarios.description: Exact amount and reference with no dates.

expected.rationale: Unique exact reference, amount, and currency suffice despite absent dates.

scenarios.description: Repeated statement transaction, only one ledger item.

expected.rationale: A single ledger row cannot safely explain repeated statement rows.

scenarios.description: Two statement rows and two ledger rows indistinguishable.

expected.rationale: Multiplicity is balanced but rows lack independent identity to safely pair.

scenarios.description: Repeated ledger candidate for a unique statement item.

expected.rationale: Multiple equally plausible ledger rows.

scenarios.description: Same reference reused for distinct amounts, one exact candidate.

expected.rationale: Reused reference indicates duplicate/collision risk despite one amount match.

scenarios.description: Duplicate statement entries differ by reference, amounts equal.

expected.rationale: One entry remains unexplained; do not collapse equal amounts.

scenarios.description: Statement amount smaller than ledger amount, same reference.

expected.rationale: Possible partial settlement requires explicit allocation evidence.

scenarios.description: Statement amount larger than ledger amount, same reference.

expected.rationale: Unexplained residual prevents full reconciliation.

scenarios.description: Two partial statement payments could sum to one ledger entry.

expected.rationale: Arithmetic sum alone is insufficient allocation evidence.

scenarios.description: Partial amount with no shared reference.

expected.rationale: Amount mismatch and conflicting references provide no safe link.

scenarios.description: Exact amount with explicitly partial status.

expected.rationale: Partial-status signal calls for investigation rather than silent closure.

scenarios.description: One statement debit equals two same-reference ledger components.

expected.rationale: Aggregate equality needs explicit grouping/allocation evidence.

scenarios.description: One statement item equals two ledger components with different references.

expected.rationale: Coincidental sum across unrelated references is ambiguous.

scenarios.description: One ledger item equals two statement entries.

expected.rationale: Many-to-one sum without allocation evidence is not an automatic match.

scenarios.description: Several candidate subsets can produce the statement total.

expected.rationale: Multiple subsets sum to the same total.

scenarios.description: Aggregate candidate differs by one cent.

expected.rationale: Near aggregate equality is not exact reconciliation.

scenarios.description: Same unique reference and value, modest date difference.

expected.rationale: Unique identifier and amount agree across one-day posting lag.

scenarios.description: Same amount, no reference, date shifted by several weeks.

expected.rationale: Weak amount-only candidate and material date gap.

scenarios.description: Same amount and reference but date in prior year.

expected.rationale: Large date separation could indicate stale or reused reference.

scenarios.description: Conflicting dates despite exact reference and amount.

expected.rationale: Unusually long delay needs human confirmation.

scenarios.description: Date is malformed on one side.

expected.rationale: Unparseable date weakens otherwise matching evidence.

scenarios.description: Net deposit equals gross ledger amount less stated fee.

expected.rationale: Fee arithmetic is plausible but needs fee policy/ledger evidence.

scenarios.description: Fee annotation does not reconcile arithmetic.

expected.rationale: Unexplained one-unit difference remains after stated fee.

scenarios.description: Ledger has separate fee entry that nets to statement.

expected.rationale: Netting principal and fee requires an explicit supported relationship.

scenarios.description: Statement fee charge has no ledger counterpart.

expected.rationale: No corresponding ledger item is present.

scenarios.description: Fee amount is negative despite labeled as fee.

expected.rationale: Invalid fee sign makes the proposed adjustment unsafe.

scenarios.description: Original payment and equal opposite reversal share identifier.

expected.rationale: Opposite-signed entries require lifecycle linkage, not direct match.

scenarios.description: Reversal amount has no equal original candidate.

expected.rationale: Reversal amount discrepancy is unexplained.

scenarios.description: Reversal and replacement payment both present.

expected.rationale: Lifecycle netting and replacement relation require explicit evidence.

scenarios.description: Opposite-sign same-value entries use unrelated references.

expected.rationale: No shared identity links reversal to payment.

scenarios.description: Reversal is marked but sign is positive.

expected.rationale: Contradictory reversal sign/type metadata.

scenarios.description: Equal numeric amounts but different currencies.

expected.rationale: Currency mismatch; no conversion evidence supplied.

scenarios.description: Cross-currency values appear exchange-rate plausible.

expected.rationale: Exchange-rate plausibility is not a documented conversion.

scenarios.description: One side has missing currency.

expected.rationale: Currency cannot be confirmed on the ledger side.

scenarios.description: Malformed currency code despite matching amount/reference.

expected.rationale: Invalid currency metadata requires correction.

scenarios.description: Same currency and exact amount, but conversion metadata conflicts.

expected.rationale: Conflicting original-currency metadata undermines certainty.

scenarios.description: Exact amount, date and currency without references.

expected.rationale: Amount/date alone may coincide; identity is missing.

scenarios.description: Missing statement amount, reference otherwise shared.

expected.rationale: Cannot compare amount when one amount is absent.

scenarios.description: Missing ledger amount.

expected.rationale: Cannot verify value equality.

scenarios.description: Only date agrees, no amount or identifiers.

expected.rationale: No identifying or monetary evidence.

scenarios.description: Null and blank references with matching values.

expected.rationale: Reference is effectively absent, leaving weak evidence.

scenarios.description: Two ledger rows share exact reference and value, dates equally close.

expected.rationale: Two equally plausible candidates; do not arbitrarily choose.

scenarios.description: Statement and ledger amounts each have multiple near candidates.

expected.rationale: No unique exact candidate and no tolerance policy supplied.

scenarios.description: Same reference appears across two unrelated ledger dates.

expected.rationale: Duplicate same-day candidates are not distinguishable.

scenarios.description: Statement reference conflicts while amount/date have multiple candidates.

expected.rationale: Identifier conflict plus candidate plurality requires human resolution.

scenarios.description: Two statement items compete for one ledger item.

expected.rationale: Global one-to-one assignment leaves a competing unmatched item.

scenarios.description: Exact reference/value candidate is more than a year old.

expected.rationale: Old candidate may be stale or reference reused.

scenarios.description: Statement entry has no current candidate but a prior-year same reference.

expected.rationale: Historical match is not sufficient evidence of current reconciliation.

scenarios.description: Exact current candidate and stale duplicate candidate both exist.

expected.rationale: Competing historical row may signal duplicate or lifecycle issue.

scenarios.description: Exact amount and reference, date absent on both sides.

expected.rationale: Recency cannot be established for a potentially stale candidate.

scenarios.description: Candidate status explicitly voided.

expected.rationale: Voided ledger entry is not an eligible active counterpart.
